title: Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy for Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Current Trends and Future Directions
journal: International Journal of Radiation Oncology, Biology, Physics / IF=7.0 / 引用量:200+
background: SBRT has emerged as a definitive local treatment for HCC, but optimal dosing, patient selection, and integration with systemic therapies remain active areas of investigation.
methods: Comprehensive review of clinical trials and retrospective studies of SBRT for HCC, including dose-escalation studies, toxicity analyses, and combination strategies.
conclusion: SBRT achieves local control rates of 80-95% for early-stage HCC with low toxicity. Challenges include BCLC stage-specific outcomes, liver function preservation, and optimal sequencing with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
innovation: Systematic framework for SBRT dose selection based on tumor size, location, and liver function; proposed risk-adapted fractionation schedules.

title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD): a growing global health priority and a real challenge for the internist.
background: MASLD has emerged as the most prevalent chronic liver disease worldwide, reflecting the global rise in metabolic disorders such as obesity and diabetes.
methods: Narrative review of epidemiology, pathophysiology, diagnostic criteria, and management strategies for MASLD.
conclusion: Internists play a central role in early detection and multidisciplinary management of MASLD to prevent progression to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
innovation: Pragmatic clinical framework for internists to screen, stage, and manage MASLD in routine practice.
